items.exampleEn: We need a chest of drawers for the baby's room.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要一個五斗櫃放在寶寶的房間。

items.exampleEn: In British English, the first floor is one level above the ground floor.
items.exampleZh: 在英式英語裡，first floor 是 ground floor 的上一層。

items.exampleEn: The first-floor rooms have a view of the river.
The shop is on the ground floor, next to the entrance.
items.exampleZh: 那家店在一樓，入口旁邊。

items.exampleEn: We gave Mom a set of glass mixing bowls for her birthday.
items.exampleZh: 我們送媽媽一組玻璃攪拌碗當生日禮物。

items.exampleEn: This remote control needs new batteries.
items.exampleZh: 這個遙控器需要換新電池。

items.exampleEn: Wash your hands in the washbowl before dinner.
items.exampleZh: 晚餐前先在洗手盆裡洗手。

items.sentenceEn: Our office is on the ground floor, so we don't need the elevator.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的辦公室在一樓，所以不用搭電梯。

items.audioEn: The kids lost the remote control again, so we can't change the channel.
items.audioZh: 孩子們又把遙控器弄丟了，所以我們沒辦法轉台。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼沒辦法轉台？
options: The TV in the living room is broken
The kids broke the remote control
The kids are asleep in their room

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother's old chest of drawers is made of wood.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶的舊五斗櫃是木頭做的。

items.sentenceEn: Mix the sugar and butter in a large mixing bowl.
items.sentenceZh: 把糖和奶油放在大攪拌碗裡拌勻。

items.stemEn: Press the red button on the ____ to turn off the TV.
items.stemZh: 按遙控器上的紅色按鈕就能關掉電視。

items.stemEn: Fold your shirts and put them in the ____.
items.stemZh: 把襯衫摺好，放進五斗櫃。

items.passageEn: We just rented a house in London. On the ground floor, there is a kitchen with a small washbowl by the back door. My mother already found a place for her mixing bowls and pots. The first floor has two bedrooms, and the first-floor windows look out on a park. In my room, there is an old chest of drawers that the last family left. The living room is relatively large, and there is a TV with a remote control.
items.passageZh: 我們剛在倫敦租了一棟房子。一樓有廚房，後門旁邊有一個小洗手盆。媽媽已經幫她的攪拌碗和鍋子找好地方放了。二樓有兩間臥室，二樓的窗戶望出去是一座公園。我房間裡有一個前一家人留下的舊五斗櫃。客廳相對寬敞，還有一台附遙控器的電視。

referenceEn: Our office is on the first floor.
Our office is on the second floor.
rubricZh: 英式說法 first floor 指二樓；寫美式的 second floor 也正確
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 我們在沙發的墊子下面找到了遙控器。
referenceEn: We found the remote control under the sofa cushion.
We found the remote control under a cushion on the sofa.
rubricZh: 用 remote control 表示「遙控器」
「沙發的墊子」可寫，例如 the sofa cushion、a cushion on the sofa 等
